tasks.short: Support, plan and coordinate actual survey operations

steps.what: Collect and verify the actual survey brief, fieldwork status, staffing availability, dependencies and constraints
inputs: Actual survey brief and field team updates
Existing survey fieldwork system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual captured availability, work status and operational constraints

steps.what: Decide the actual work allocation, dependencies, timing and support priorities for the survey
inputs: Actual verified constraints and status from s1
outputs: Researcher-selected and captured operational assignments, dates and intended recipients

steps.what: Fill the exact selected assignments and dates into the native operational plan and draft coordination notice
inputs: Actual explicit assignments, dates, dependencies and recipients captured in s2
outputs: Draft plan entries and coordination notice with exact selected fields

steps.what: Complete the actual plan and notice wording and check the entire final versions for allocation, feasibility, dependencies and recipients
inputs: Complete draft entries and notice from s3
Original survey constraints and decisions
outputs: Exact complete checked final plan and coordination notice

steps.what: Commit the exact checked operational plan entries
inputs: Exact final plan checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual operational plan

steps.what: Send the exact checked coordination notice to the selected internal survey colleagues
inputs: Exact final notice and recipients checked in s4
outputs: Actual coordination notice sent with delivery result

steps.what: Support actual fieldwork and resolve questions and coordination problems with survey colleagues
inputs: Actual survey work and questions after the plan is communicated
outputs: Human support and resolved or escalated operational questions

tasks.design: Configure native {PROJECT} plan and notice fields from actual allocations chosen and captured by the researcher. Keep planning, colleague consultation, complete final checking and fieldwork support human, with separate plan commit and internal notice send.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual coordination episode can repeat selected assignments and dates across plan fields and a notice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project fields and notice templates can reuse exact selected operational information.
tasks.still_hard: Survey dependencies and fieldwork exceptions need decisions based on real staffing and sample conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve conflicting priorities and support colleagues when the actual plan stops fitting the fieldwork.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project tools can reproduce selected assignments and dates in plans and notices without choosing survey staffing or resolving fieldwork issues.

assumptions: This conditional episode contains actual manually entered allocations and an internal coordination notice. Shares are provisional, not measured or derived from the prompt prior; do not extrapolate to all support duties without observing their mix.

Colleagues produce ordinary status and availability updates as existing work. The researcher collects and verifies them in s1 and actually decides and captures every assignment and recipient in s2; no clean staffing feed or automatic scheduling decision is assumed.
Native configuration is tried first. Existing plan and notice field reuse is baseline and earns no new gain. Actual notice wording and feasibility checking stay in s4.

The researcher has ordinary coordination authority. Any required additional owner review must examine the complete final version and its actual labour must be added. Edits invalidate gates; a save is negligible and earns no gain.

No automatic fieldwork reassignment, respondent contact, sample release or performance scoring occurs. Any changed plan found during s7 returns through actual plan preparation and checking; it is not silently committed.
unknowns: Actual plan entry duplication and coordination authority
research_questions: Observe one coordination cycle and measure actual repeated allocation fields separately from planning and support.

already_counted.description: Source consultation, actual allocation decisions, complete final plan and notice check and fieldwork support remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain plan and notice mappings and resolve integration exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete operational plan checked in s4; changes invalidate the check.
Exact final coordination notice and internal recipients checked in s4; changes require renewed checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross saving=25 from actual repeated plan and notice fields. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 22. No gain from existing configuration, saves or live support.

tasks.short: Monitor survey progress using disposition reports and response rates

steps.what: Verify actual sample case events, disposition definitions, reporting cut-off and denominator rules, resolving missing and ambiguous cases
inputs: Actual recorded survey fieldwork events and sample register
Existing survey collection system, defined as OTHER
Actual agreed response-rate and disposition definitions
outputs: Verified actual source events, explicit mappings, cut-off and denominator rules with unresolved cases exposed

steps.what: Import the exact verified sample and event records into the native disposition reporting table
inputs: Actual verified case events and explicit mappings from s1
outputs: Draft source-linked case disposition table with unmatched or duplicate cases exposed

steps.what: Calculate exact disposition totals and response rates using the selected definitions, cut-off and denominator rules
inputs: Actual case disposition table from s2
Explicit checked definitions and denominator rules from s1
outputs: Draft reproducible disposition report and response-rate calculations with unresolved cases visible

steps.what: Monitor and evaluate actual survey progress and performance, checking totals, response patterns and implications of unresolved dispositions
inputs: Actual source-linked reports from s3 and original case evidence
outputs: Human progress and performance assessment and actual concerns

steps.what: Record the actual monitoring findings and check the complete final report for source reconciliation, definitions, uncertainty and conclusions
inputs: Actual assessment from s4, source records and calculation outputs
outputs: Exact complete checked monitoring report and findings

steps.what: Save the exact checked monitoring report and findings
inputs: Exact complete final report checked in s5
outputs: Saved actual monitoring report

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} to {BI} disposition imports and exact response-rate calculations using definitions selected by the researcher. Keep missing-case resolution, actual progress evaluation and the full final report check human before saving the actual findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual manually assembled progress report repeats case transfer and fixed rate calculations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native survey exports and reporting formulas can produce reproducible disposition counts and explicit denominators.
tasks.still_hard: A correct calculation cannot decide whether ambiguous case status or differential response threatens the survey.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret progress and distinguish a rate change from a substantive fieldwork problem.

ambition.what: Review verified progress at additional actual cut-offs without rebuilding the tables.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: disposition counts and response-rate formulas can be calculated deterministically from actual case events and explicit denominator definitions.

assumptions: This conditional episode contains actual manual case import and reporting calculations. Shares are illustrative and independent of the supplied prior; no observed time saving is claimed.

Field staff produce real dispositions during normal existing fieldwork; their capture remains baseline labour. The focal researcher verifies actual events, resolves ambiguities and explicitly captures mapping and denominator choices in s1. No clean disposition feed is assumed.
Use native survey reports and exports first. Already automatic response rates, case feeds and report runtime are baseline and earn no additional gain.
Missing or duplicate cases remain visible and return to retained source resolution; no model invents dispositions. All interpretation and actual findings writing remain in s4-s5.

The complete final report exists before its check and separate negligible save. No automatic respondent contact, fieldwork change, alert or report send is hidden; any actual action needs its own final-version check and step.
unknowns: Actual existing native reporting and ambiguous-case workload
research_questions: Can one observed disposition report be reconciled exactly to its actual case events and agreed denominator?

already_counted.description: Actual case verification, performance interpretation and complete findings writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain disposition mappings and denominator definitions and test reporting exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact entire monitoring report and findings checked in s5 against actual case evidence; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55; gross saving=45 from actual manual import and calculation. Deduct 4 incremental hours once for net 41. Existing native report automation and the save earn no new gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate with researchers on survey planning, implementation and evaluation

steps.what: Locate and read the actual survey plan, fieldwork results and questions needed for the collaboration
inputs: Actual survey materials and colleagues' questions
outputs: Prepared actual evidence and understood discussion questions

steps.what: Collaborate with the other researchers on actual survey design, implementation issues and evaluation choices
inputs: Actual survey evidence and discussion questions from s1
outputs: Human discussion, agreements, unresolved issues and selected working-plan changes

steps.what: Write the actual agreed working-plan update and check its complete final meaning, reusing exact existing survey identifiers in native fields
inputs: Actual agreed changes captured during s2
Specific survey identifiers selected in s1
outputs: Complete actual working-plan update checked against the discussion and original plan

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual working-plan update
inputs: Exact complete update checked in s3
outputs: Saved actual working-plan update with unresolved issues preserved

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} and {PROJECT} views to locate actual collaboration material and reuse exact survey identifiers in an actual working-plan update. Keep researcher discussion, substantive update writing and its complete final check human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current survey material and repeating its exact identifiers can interrupt collaboration.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed views and linked document fields can reuse specific existing survey records.
tasks.still_hard: Methodological disagreement and implications for the actual survey require researcher judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Make and explain shared research choices with colleagues.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document and project views can reduce locating current survey records and copying exact identifiers without replacing researcher collaboration.

assumptions: This illustrative collaboration actually updates an existing working plan. Do not invent a report after every conversation or extrapolate this mix to all collaboration; shares are not measured or based on the supplied prior.
Substantive reading remains in s1. Actual agreements and changes are produced and captured by the researcher in s2; s3 retains all substantive wording and full final meaning checking.
Native views and fixed fields are tried first. Existing equivalent configuration is baseline. There is no model-created agreement, transcript, survey decision or hidden send.

The ordinary final working-plan check gates its separate negligible save; changed meaning requires renewed checking. Any actual approved survey release or notification is separate work and action, not implied by this save.
If this is the same actual plan update and coordination notice as 7556, count it once. Where collaboration has no actual written update, remove s3-s4 and reassess only the real source lookup.
unknowns: Actual written working-plan changes and current document navigation
research_questions: Does the observed collaboration update a real existing plan, and which fields are repeated?

already_counted.description: Remaining source work, actual collaboration and substantive working-plan writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain current-document views and exact survey-field links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete actual working-plan update checked in s3 against the discussion; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=95.1; gross saving=4.9 from actual lookup and fixed fields. Deduct 1.5 incremental hours once for net 3.4; no reduction to discussion, substantive writing or save.

tasks.short: Research actual survey topics using traceable sources

steps.what: Search the actual survey topic using researcher-selected queries and native source-library filters
inputs: Actual survey research question
Existing reference library and research catalogue, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual candidate source records selected for reading

steps.what: Read and evaluate the actual candidate sources for relevance, quality and limitations and capture selected passages and source records
inputs: Actual source texts found in s1
outputs: Human-selected source evidence and verified source records with limitations

steps.what: Import the exact selected source metadata and references into the native research-note reference list
inputs: Actual verified and selected source metadata from s2
outputs: Draft source-linked research-note reference list

steps.what: Interpret the actual evidence to identify what it establishes about the survey topic and what remains unknown
inputs: Actual selected source texts and evidence from s2
outputs: Human topic findings, contradictory evidence and research gaps

steps.what: Write and check the entire actual research note, findings and references against the original source texts
inputs: Actual findings from s4, exact references from s3 and original source texts
outputs: Exact complete checked topic-research note with supported claims and open gaps

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual topic-research note
inputs: Exact complete note checked in s5
outputs: Saved actual source-linked topic-research note

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} search filters and exact reference imports into the actual {DOCS} topic-research note. Keep full source reading, quality assessment, interpretation and actual findings writing human, checking the entire final note before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and manual bibliographic entry can interrupt substantive topic research.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue filtering and reference imports can reuse actual selected records without inventing citations.
tasks.still_hard: Relevant-looking sources may not support the survey's actual question or population.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the topic evidence and identify what it cannot establish.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reference catalogues support query filters and exact bibliographic imports while source evaluation and topic interpretation remain human.

assumptions: This conditional research episode has actual manual searching and reference entry into a real research note. Shares are provisional and not derived from the supplied prior or a claimed study.

The researcher chooses actual queries in s1 and reads, selects and captures actual source evidence and records in s2. No free structured evidence base, invented citation or model summary substitutes for reading.

Native search and reference tools are tried first; already efficient search, imported references and runtime are baseline. Missing source text or metadata remains manual and cannot be filled from model memory.

All substantive interpretation and actual note writing remain in s4-s5. The complete final note exists before its check and separate negligible save. No publication, questionnaire change or hidden send is performed.
unknowns: Actual existing reference tooling and source availability
research_questions: Which actual navigation and metadata-entry effort remains after current native tools are used?

incremental.description: Maintain source filters and reference mappings and resolve unavailable-source exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete actual research note and references checked against original source texts in s5; edits invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross saving=25 from actual searching and metadata import. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 22. Source interpretation and the save remain unchanged; existing native automation earns no additional gain.
